work_identified: Chronologia sive De tempore et eius mutationibus ecclesiasticis tractatio theologica libris duobus comprehensa — Heinrich Wolf (1551–1594), Zurich 1585. A Reformed theological treatise on ecclesiastical time and calendar, arguing (inter alia) for an autumn birth of Christ. Distinct from other Chronologia works of the period (Mercator 1569, Glareanus, Scaliger 1583).
